summary: National CineMedia, Inc. reported that its wholly-owned subsidiary NCM Holdings, LLC closed the previously announced acquisition of Captivate Holdings, LLC and Captivate Network Holdings, Inc. on September 18, 2026. Concurrently, the buyer entered a credit agreement with Crestline Direct Finance as administrative and collateral agent, comprising a fully funded $275.0 million senior secured first lien term loan plus a $25.0 million revolver, with $10.0 million drawn at closing. Proceeds financed the acquisition, repaid Captivate debt, refinanced the U.S. Bank credit agreement, and covered fees. Term loan and revolver each mature September 18, 2031, priced at SOFR plus 7.00% or base rate plus 6.00%.
